items.title: Russia used ChatGPT to run a covert influence campaign pushing pro-Kremlin narratives across the West
items.summary: OpenAI has disrupted a covert Russian influence campaign that used ChatGPT to generate social media posts by banning a cluster of accounts. The operators accessed the platform through VPNs from Russia and promoted the fictitious "International Burke Institute," including German-language Telegram content critical of the EU and the German government. The campaign's reach stayed small, but OpenAI warns the infrastructure behind it could have been scaled up over time. The article Russia used ChatGPT to run a covert influence campaign pushing pro-Kremlin narratives across the West appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 封鎖了一批帳號，破壞了一場利用 ChatGPT 平臺在社群媒體上釋出內容的秘密俄羅斯影響力活動。這些業者透過 VPN 從俄羅斯訪問該平臺，並推廣虛構的“國際伯克研究所”，其中包括在 Telegram 上發布批評歐盟和德國政府的德語內容。該活動的規模目前還比較小，但 OpenAI 警告稱，其背後的基礎設施可能會隨著時間的推移而擴大。文章《俄羅斯利用 ChatGPT 在西方開展秘密影響力活動，傳播親克里姆林宮的敘事》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

items.title: OpenAI's first custom chip "Jalapeño" reportedly beats Nvidia's Blackwell and Rubin in inference benchmarks
items.summary: OpenAI showed off "Jalapeño," its first in-house inference chip, with benchmarks at the Hot Chips conference. According to SemiAnalysis tests, the chip beats Nvidia's Blackwell and even Rubin in throughput and energy efficiency. "Usually first generation chips aren't competitive, but OpenAI is beating Nvidia Blackwell and even Rubin," SemiAnalysis CEO Dylan Patel said. The article OpenAI's first custom chip "Jalapeño" reportedly beats Nvidia's Blackwell and Rubin in inference benchmarks appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 在 Hot Chips 大會上展示了其首款自主研發的推理晶片“Jalapeño”，並進行了基準測試。根據 SemiAnalysis 的測試，該晶片在吞吐量和能源效率方面均超越了輝達的 Blackwell 和 Rubin。 「通常第一代晶片不具備競爭力，但 OpenAI 卻擊敗了輝達的 Blackwell 甚至 Rubin，」SemiAnalysis 執行長 Dylan Patel 表示。文章《OpenAI's 首款客製化晶片「Jalapeño」據稱在推理基準測試中擊敗輝達的 Blackwell 和 Rubin》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

items.title: Nvidia says its Groq 3 LPX is four times faster than Cerebras, but the math is more complicated
items.summary: Nvidia is moving its Groq 3 LPX inference chip into full production and reports 3,400 tokens per second on Gemma 4 31B, four times faster than Cerebras. But the numbers don't tell the whole story. Nvidia needs at least 64 accelerators to get there, while Cerebras needs only one or two, according to The Register. How well the architecture scales with large MoE models remains an open question. The article Nvidia says its Groq 3 LPX is four times faster than Cerebras, but the math is more complicated appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 輝達正將其 Groq 3 LPX 推理晶片投入全面量產，並報告稱其在 Gemma 4 31B 平臺上的運算速度達到每秒 3400 個令牌，比 Cerebras 快四倍。但這些數字並不能說明全部問題。根據 The Register 報導，輝達至少需要 64 個加速器才能達到這一速度，而 Cerebras 只需要一到兩個。該架構在處理大型 MoE 模型時擴充套件性如何，目前仍是一個懸而未決的問題。這篇文章《輝達稱其 Groq 3 LPX 比 Cerebras 快四倍，但計算過程更為複雜》最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.summary: The UK becomes the first country to get access to Avengers Labs, Ukraine's platform holding roughly five million annotated combat images for training military AI. Three British startups are already working on pilot projects. The deal shows how real war data is systematically becoming the currency for building out autonomous weapons tech. items.summary: Alabama Attorney General Steve Marshall is investigating OpenAI over what he calls an "AI lab leak." The probe follows the July 2026 Hugging Face incident, where an OpenAI agent broke out of a test environment and gained internet access on its own. items.summary: 紐西蘭政府8月24日提出兒童線上安全法案，擬禁止未滿16歲兒少在受年齡限制的社群平臺持有帳號，並要求業者採取合理措施確認使用者年齡。法案也要求相關平臺定期評估兒童安全風險，社交型AI陪伴服務同樣納入年齡限制，違規企業最高可處全球年營收10%的罰款。 紐西蘭政府以Instagram、TikTok、Snapchat與臉書等高風險社群平臺為例，業者可利用既有帳戶資料、臉部年齡估算、數位身分服務或正式身分證件等方式，確認使用者是否年滿16歲。
